# Bello Entertainment

> Owner-operated DJ & event entertainment company based in New Jersey, run by Joe. Weddings, sweet 16s, corporate events, baby showers, communions and special occasions across New Jersey (especially Monmouth & Middlesex Counties), Staten Island and Brooklyn, NY. Rated 5.0 on Google. Insured, professional gear with full backups, every package includes MC/hosting and 4 hours of coverage.

Contact: inquire@belloentertainmentnj.com · +1-732-995-8719
Service area: Monmouth County NJ (Freehold, Middletown, Red Bank), Middlesex County NJ (Edison, Woodbridge, Old Bridge, East Brunswick, Metuchen), all of New Jersey, Staten Island NY, Brooklyn NY, greater NYC.
